When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

391-1556-2645-3430.description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding twelve {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.

Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.

985-1251-5078-8171.description:

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.

Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.

1887-5254-5256.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
1887-5254-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill card(s)
Repeat.

1339-3899-7920.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3899-7920.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2511-4419-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2511-4419-4694-7306.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

1765-6888-8095.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

690-4624.description:
Cast Revenge by paying {4}{W}{B}, doubling your life total and causing an opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
Sanugine Bond triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

2919-6719-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1368-1563-4785-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-4785-6321.description:

Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

3259-7175-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
3259-7175-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7175-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-7175-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Lavaleaper so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

5475-7163-7172.description:
Activate Sunken Palace's second ability by paying {1}{U}, tapping it and exiling seven cards from your graveyard, adding {U}.
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, ensuring to use the mana from Sunken Palace, targeting a triggered ability.
Sunken Palace triggers. Holding priority, activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {1}{R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Sunken Palace's trigger twice.
Resolve the first Sunken Palace trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting a Sunken Palace trigger.
Resolve the Mister Fantastic ability, copying Sunken Palace's trigger twice.
Repeat from step 6.

When Chainbreaker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 5.

Resolve the Woe Strider ability.

When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

1305-4068-6575.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1305-4068-6575.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

222-413-527-4785.easyPrerequisites:

222-413-527-4785.description:

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.

When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

974-1305-1995-4417-6674.easyPrerequisites: Rydia does not have summoning sickness.
974-1305-1995-4417-6674.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Rydia by paying {5} and tapping it, returning There and Back Again from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. As There and Back Again enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing the finality counter from There and Back Again.
Resolve the There and Back Again trigger, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering its ability, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate ten Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}{W}{B}.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Rydia.
Repeat from step 2.

Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

When the Diamond Lion token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Diamond Lion by discarding your hand, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
